_about: Public-domain James Fraser of Brea (1639-1698, Covenanter, minister at Culross) for the Word Hoard: 6 posthumous first printings from Internet Archive scans, 1721-1749: Meditations on Several Subjects in Divinity (1721), A Treatise concerning Justifying or Saving Faith (1722), his Memoirs written by himself (first edition 1738), Prelacy an Idol (1742), The Lawfulness and Duty of Separation (1744) and A Treatise on Justifying Faith (1749). Raw OCR, long-s throughout; two are rough ECCO scans. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

fraser-brea-meditations: Meditations on Several Subjects in Divinity, particularly Trusting upon God, Hungring and Thirsting after Christ (Edinburgh: for John Macky, M.DCC.XXI)
fraser-brea-saving-faith-1722: A Treatise concerning Justifying or Saving Faith, written while prisoner in the Bass, 1679 (Edinburgh: John Mosman, 1722)
fraser-brea-memoirs: Memoirs of the Life of the very Reverend Mr. James Fraser of Brea, written by himself, first edition (Edinburgh: Thomas Lumisden and John Robertson, M.DCCXXXVIII)
fraser-brea-prelacy-idol: Prelacy an Idol, and Prelates Idolaters, a sermon, second edition (Linlithgow: for George Paton, 1742)
fraser-brea-separation: The Lawfulness and Duty of Separation from Corrupt Ministers and Churches Explained and Vindicated (Edinburgh: for George Paton, MDCCXLIV)
fraser-brea-justifying-faith-1749: A Treatise on Justifying Faith, with an Appendix concerning the Extent of Christ's Death, never before printed (Edinburgh: William Gray, MDCCXLIX)

_alternates.fraser-brea-choice-meditations: Some Choice, Select Meditations (catalogued 1726; IA bim_eighteenth-century_some-choice-select-medi_fraser-james_1726): name garbled on the title page, OCR very rough
_alternates.fraser-brea-memoirs-later: Memoirs, later editions: Glasgow 1798 (memoirslifevery00frasgoog; ECCO copy); fourth edition, Aberdeen 1843 (dli.bengal.10689.20064); Inverness 1891 with matter by Alexander Whyte and Gustavus Aird (memoirsofjame00fras, memoirsofrevjame00fras); ECCO copy of 1738
_alternates.fraser-brea-select-biographies: Tweedie's Select Biographies vol. II (Wodrow Society, 1847; selectbiographi02twee): edited text of the Memoirs within a collection
